_source: Seljuk_Units_and_Strongholds.txt (Player Aid Forces), errata applied. Strike value = dice rolled per unit (0.5 = x1/2); sum within a step, round up. Protection range: roll within range cancels the Hit, else Rout. All dice d6.

capability_modifiers.BARDOUKIA: -1 to target Armor during each Melee Strike step of Battle (roll those Hits' Protection separately)

capability_modifiers.NORMAN_HEAVY_CAVALRY: reroll 1 unit's Armor each Missiles AND Melee step (two rerolls, possibly different units)

melee.note: Turkic Horse have NO base Melee; Shock Tactics grants it (D-002, Playbook pp.14,17).

unarmored.applies_to: Missile Hits, and any Hits in Storm

evade.applies_to: Melee Hits in Battle only (not Missiles, not Storm)

capability_modifiers.PARTHIAN_SHOT: select Missile targets in Battle (not Storm)
capability_modifiers.SHOCK_TACTICS: half of this Lord's Turkic Horse (round up) do x1/2 Melee each
capability_modifiers.LAMELLAR_ARMOR: Armor 1-3 until 3 Turkic Horse Rout from this Lord; per Melee Hit may use Lamellar OR Evade, not both (errata)

special_rules.pursuit_exception: a single Conceding Lord with ONLY Turkic Horse at battle start facing a single opposing Lord causes BOTH sides' Hits to be halved in Pursuit

varangian_guard.melee_restriction: may Strike in first Round only, no halving for Pursuit (mark) [errata: 'attack in Melee' corrected to 'Strike']

garrison_storm.rule: 4.9.1 (gains x1/2 Missiles as Garrison even without JAVELINS)

capability_modifiers.JAVELINS: any 1 Round: x1 Missiles in Battle (not Storm)
capability_modifiers.ALAKATIA: with >=2 Unrouted Infantry, add 1 extra Missile Hit with -1 to target Armor (does not scale beyond 2)
capability_modifiers.STEELED_RESOLVE: Armor 1-4 vs Horse for any 1 Round of Battle (mark)

garrison_storm.rule: 4.9.1 (Roman Garrison Militia have x1/2 Missiles by default)

capability_modifiers.PSILOI: non-garrison Roman Militia have Missiles x1/2 (board edge, ALL; not attached to a Lord)
capability_modifiers.SYNDOSIS: Armor 1-2 (vs both Missiles and Melee; not used for post-Battle Losses)
